[ptvm-p01-v01] O Lord, what is the Unsurpassable that grants Kaula fruit at once — known by a mere touch of knowing, rising to kinship with the Sky-Goer?

[ptvm-p01-v02] Tell me this secret of secrets, Lord — the Power that dwells in the heart, Kaulikī, mistress of the clan.

[ptvm-p01-v03] Tell me of her, Lord of gods, by whom I come to fullness. — Hear, blessed Goddess: even the answer has one beyond it — the Unsurpassable.

[ptvm-p01-v04] This Kaula rite, O Goddess, standing in my heart-sky — I tell it, O lady of gods: it gives swift Kaula fruit.

[ptvm-p01-v05] First now: all lunar days, vowels ending in the drop; within them, by time's conjoining, moon and sun are named.

[ptvm-p01-v06] Realities from earth to person, in five groups in order — in ka-series, in sounds, ending with the ma-sound, O fair-vowed one.

[ptvm-p01-v07] Fourfold the holds of wind, fire, water and their lords; above them, śa beginning the famed row, and before, the five Brahmas.

[ptvm-p01-v08] Rootless, rightly ranged, to be known, ending in kṣa — this forthgoing declared; of all mantras indeed, and of wisdoms, O glorious one.

[ptvm-p01-v09] This is the womb, told in all Tantras in every way — joined with the fourteen, O lucky one, joined with the tithi-lord's end; the third godhead, O fair-hipped, the heart of Bhairava himself.

[ptvm-p02-v10] Neither yoginī-born nor Rudra plainly wins this heart of the god of gods, swift giver of yoga's release.

[ptvm-p02-v11] At its right speaking, the great mantra-seal host comes face to face at once — marked by possession of one's own body.

[ptvm-p02-v12] Who remembers for a moment — in the kiss, navel-sealed — he binds then all, body and mantra-seal host, the man.

[ptvm-p02-v13] Asked, he tells past and future things — even within a watch, uttering the meant god-form.

[ptvm-p02-v14] Face to face he sees the sure, drawn by Rudra's powers; in two watches' time, sky-standing, remembering.

[ptvm-p02-v15] By three: all mothers, mighty yoginīs, heroes, hero-lords, adepts, and the strong śākinī throng.

[ptvm-p02-v16] They come, pledge got, by Bhairava urged — they grant supreme fruition, whatever fruit is wished.

[ptvm-p02-v17] By this the perfected will perfect, and make mantra-men perfect; whatever is in Bhairava's Tantra, all succeeds from this.

[ptvm-p02-v18] Who thus truly knows even the unseen circle shares fruition ever — yogin and initiate alike.

[ptvm-p03-v19] By this mere knowing, all powers know; a kinsman of the śākinī clan he may be, even without yoga.

[ptvm-p03-v20] Ignorant of rite, knowing ordinance, he turns to worship — having made time-fire from the first, ending in māyā, gone to the brahma-body.

[ptvm-p03-v21] Śiva, whose end is endless all, deemed the supreme power-triad; whatever stands on the pure path abides inside that.

[ptvm-p03-v22] The atom soon attains pure lordly knowing; its mover is Śiva to be known, all-knowing highest Lord.

[ptvm-p03-v23] All-going, stainless, clear, full, self-aboded, bright — like the great power-formed tree standing in the banyan seed.

[ptvm-p03-v24] So stands this moving-still world in the heart-seed; who knows it truly — his is the freedom-going.

[ptvm-p03-v25] Initiation becomes undoubted, free of sesame-ghee offering — on crown, face, and heart, on the hidden, on the form, and so indeed.

[ptvm-p03-v26] Placing done, topknot bound, twenty-seven-muttered; with each one let the ten quarters' binding be yoked.

[ptvm-p03-v27] Three claps first, sounded, to clear obstacles; with topknot-count thrice-told, then sprinkle water.

[ptvm-p04-v28] Flowers and all in order — emblem or altar; with fourteen mutterings, a flower-seat made.

[ptvm-p04-v29] There let the hero worship the forthgoing, then the seat again; casketed, let him begin the worship after.

[ptvm-p04-v30] Full of all realities, graced with all ornaments — let the great lady worship the goddess, twenty-seven-named.

[ptvm-p04-v31] Then with fragrant flowers, as able, let him honor; worship with supreme devotion, and offer up himself.

[ptvm-p04-v32] Thus worship told; in fire-rite too this rule: who did the worship-rule, rightly remembering the seed, succeeds.

[ptvm-p04-v33] Beginningless-endless seed, abloom, gone mid-tithis — housed in the heart-lotus, meditate the moon-ray, ever practise.

[ptvm-p04-v34] Which desires he desires, them quickly may he win; from this he goes to direct sight — all-knowingness, no doubt.

[ptvm-p04-v35] Thus is mantra-fruit got — this Rudrayāmala; from this practice, accomplishment and all-knowingness are won.
